 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Vancouver Canucks wrap up their two-game road trip on Thursday when they battle the San Jose Sharks . After snapping their 10-game winless streak, Vancouver will be looking for their first win streak of he season. Here are the lineup notes for October 29, 2026.
 Based on morning skate, the Canucks will not be making any lineup changes from their win on Tuesday. This means Luke Schenn, Brendan Gallagher and Guillaume Brisebois are the projected healthy scratches. A few milestones to watch are Filip Hronek, who is on 49 career goals and 248 career assists.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement As for the starting goaltender, Leevi Meriläinen is the projected starter for Thursday night. The 24-year-old has two of Vancouver's three wins this season and will be making his third straight start. This year, Meriläinen has a .900 save percentage and a 3.35 goals-against average.
 Projected Lineup:
 DeBrusk-Pettersson-Boeser
O'Connor-Chytil-Lekkerimäki
Öhgren-Rossi-Karlsson
Cotter-Sasson-Bains
 Pettersson-Hronek
Oleksiak-Willander
Buium-Mancini
 Meriläinen
Lankinen
 Game Information:
 Start time: 7:00 pm PT
 Venue: SAP Center
 Television: Sportsnet
 Radio: KiSS West Coast
